Abstract
Large language models have ushered in a new
era of artificial intelligence research. However,
their substantial training costs hinder further de-
velopment and widespread adoption. In this pa-
per, inspired by the redundancy in the parameters
of large language models, we propose a novel
training paradigm: Evolving Subnetwork Train-
ing (EST). EST samples subnetworks from the
